title: Understanding Inequality of LLM Fact-Checking over Geographic Regions with Agent and Retrieval Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing the factual accuracy of LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, LLaMA 3.3) on a balanced dataset of 600 fact-checked statements originating from six different global regions (Africa, Asia-Pacific, Europe, Latin America, North America, Middle East). The evaluation is conducted across three scenarios (statement-only, RAG-based, and agent-based) to measure performance disparities between the Global North and the Global South.
